title: Build password reset flow with email-based reset tokens
acceptance_criteria: Forgot password page at /auth/forgot-password requests email and sends reset link
Reset password page at /auth/reset-password/[token] validates token and allows new password
Token stored in database with user_id, hashed token, and expiry
Email sending uses Nodemailer or Resend with templated email
Success/failure messages displayed clearly (no information leakage on 'email not found')
Password strength indicator on new password input
